correctness.rationale: Unique shadow-spin elimination follows because each local coefficient sums three +/-1 spins and is odd. It transforms H/J exactly into -2(B+T); the identity F=3k-2C1-D2 and the run-count bound C1>=2k-n together with transitivity of the shift by two at odd n prove the maximum and classify every equality case. All-zero and all-one cases, even and odd boundary values and magnetization counts are included. Full physical brute force n=4..11 and an independent cyclic transfer n=4..201 passed; these finite tests supplement, not replace, the all-n proof.

value.rationale: This infinite, natural, triangle-free graph family is obtained by an established chromatic-lifting operation. The exact opposite parity degeneracy behavior (4 versus 2n), single mobile defect, and uniform minimal |M|=1 expose a structural connection between chromatic obstruction, frustrated edges, and zero-temperature state multiplicity. Results hold for every finite size without relying on a small-graph census and furnish a reproducible benchmark; no phase-transition or extensive-entropy claim is made.
